title: Crucible Vendor Adapter Pack
description: A signed, portable unit of learned vendor knowledge. Data only: a pack describes a grammar and field mappings, and can never compute. An unsigned or signature-invalid pack is refused at import, not warned about. DRAFT - freezes in Phase 2.

ir_version.description: The IR schema version this pack targets. A pack may only name IR paths that exist in that version.

fingerprint.description: Signatures that identify this vendor from an unknown file. Never sufficient on its own: fingerprint confidence is recorded on the device, not asserted.

ir_path.description: Dotted IR path. Must exist in the IR version this pack declares.

match.description: Match expression over configuration text. Data, not code.

transform.description: Named transform from the fixed library. There is deliberately no expression language: a pack that could compute could also lie in a way a reviewer cannot see.

confirmed_by.description: Set when a human confirmed the mapping at Tier 3.

samples.description: Count only. Sample TEXT is stripped at export: a pack carries knowledge of a grammar, never fragments of a customer configuration.

value.description: Base64. Covers the canonical serialisation of every field except this one.
